claim: In an RCT of 80 adults with temporal-lobe epilepsy, 58% of patients randomised to surgery vs 8% randomised to one year of medical therapy were free of seizures impairing awareness at one year (P<0.001).

bibliographic_record.authors: Wiebe S, Blume WT, Girvin JP, Eliasziw M; Effectiveness and Efficiency of Surgery for Temporal Lobe Epilepsy Study Group
bibliographic_record.title: A randomized, controlled trial of surgery for temporal-lobe epilepsy
